questions.question:
**Given below are the four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

 

A. An astrologer passing through the village had foretold that Velan would live in a three-storey house surrounded by many acres of garden.

B. But thirty or forty years later, the prophecy became true.

C. No one could believe him because Vela and his family were very poor.

D. Velan became the sole occupant of a grand house in Kimar Baugh.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "ACBD".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

The given question is an example of a Para Jumble. 

We know that the first statement of a para-jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once.

__
 
• **Sentence A** will be the starting sentence, It tells about 'An astrologer who was passing through, It is a general independent statement
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because It connects the previous sentence it further tells about an astrologer that no one could believe him.
 
• **Sentence B **will be the next sentence because It describes that the prediction of the astrologer became true.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence D** will be the last sentence which talks about Velan becoming the owner of the three-storey house. That was predicted by the Astrologer.

Thus, the correct sequence is,

 
• A. An astrologer passing through the village had foretold that Velan would live in a three-storey house surrounded by many acres of garden.
 
• C. No one could believe him because Vela and his family were very poor..
 
• B. But thirty or forty years later, the prophecy became true.
 
• D. Velan became the sole occupant of a grand house in Kimar Baugh.

***Correct answer: ***__ACBD

**Direction: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It is a known fact that they perform tasks such as hunting, farming, and acting as security!

B. Further, dogs have an amazing sense of hearing and can hear sounds at four times the distance than humans can.

C. Typically, they are great helpers and can be trained to help people with disabilities.

D. Dogs are known as 'man's best friends for a reason.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DCAB.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in the options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The first sentence should be D as it is providing an introduction to the subject** "Dogs."**
 
• C follows D because it is adding information about the helping nature of dogs.
 
• A follows C because it is adding information about the tasks that dogs can perform.
 
• B follows A as it is concluding the context by further telling about the qualities of dogs.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the sequence is 'DCAB.'

Correct sequence__:

D. Dogs are known as 'man's best friends for a reason.

C. Typically, they are great helpers and can be trained to help people with disabilities.

A. It is a known fact that they perform tasks such as hunting, farming, and acting as security!

B. Further, dogs have an amazing sense of hearing and can hear sounds at four times the distance than humans can.

questions.question:
**Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful paragraph.**

A. In fact, there are a thousand lessons that nature can teach us.

B. The greatest lesson that she teaches us is to maintain an equilibrium in life.

C. Nature is our mother, our first teacher.

D. We also learn to maintain composure through our joys, sorrows and fears.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'CBDA'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual__ connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. **

__
 
• Sentence **C **is the independent sentence and introduces the topic which relates to nature, our mother and our first teacher.
 
• So, sentence **C **is the **first **sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• Sentence **B **describes the greatest lesson imparted to us by nature which relates to maintaining equilibrium. Hence, **B follows C.__**
 
• Sentence **D **which explains some more lessons we learn from nature should come after sentence** B**, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
 
• Sentence **A** is the concluding statement of the passage as it states that there are many more such lessons as mentioned before that can be taught to us by nature. 

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is **option 1 i.e. CBDA.**

**So, the correct paragraph is: *****C.** Nature is our mother, our first teacher.**B.** The greatest lesson that she teaches us is to maintain an equilibrium in life. **D. **We also learn to maintain composure through our joys, sorrows and fears. **A.** In fact, there are a thousand lessons that nature can teach us.*

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. The novel Beloved offers a harrowing look at slavery and its lasting impact.

Q. Morrison's beautiful language and intense imagery, however, were rightly celebrated in this classic work.

R. A film adaptation of her novel starring Oprah Winfrey was released in 1998.

S. The intensely moving narrative was ambiguously written.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**PSQR**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a **Para **Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence P** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory general statement that talks about the novel '**Beloved**'.
 
• After it,** Sentence S **will be used because it further explains that this novel is intensely moving. And it is written ambiguously.
 
• **Sentence S** tells us that the novel is written ambiguously and **Sentence Q** tells further about the language of the novel. Hence, both are connected.
 
• Lastly,** Sentence R** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **P**: The novel Beloved offers a harrowing look at slavery and its lasting impact.
 
• **S**: The intensely moving narrative was ambiguously written.
 
• **Q**: Morrison's beautiful language and intense imagery, however, were rightly celebrated in this classic work.
 
• **R**: A film adaptation of her novel starring Oprah Winfrey was released in 1998.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *The novel Beloved offers a harrowing look at slavery and its lasting impact. The intensely moving narrative was ambiguously written. Morrison's beautiful language and intense imagery, however, were rightly celebrated in this classic work. A film adaptation of her novel starring Oprah Winfrey was released in 1998.*

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. Before their recapture, Margaret killed her young daughter to prevent her return to slavery.

Q. Margaret escaped from a Kentucky plantation with her husband, Robert, and their children in 1856.

R. They sought refuge in Ohio, but their owner and law officers soon caught up with the family.

S. The novel Beloved by Toni Morrison is based on the true story of a black slave woman, Margaret Garner.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**SQRP**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence S** will be the first sentence because it is an independent general statement that talks about a novel written by Toni Morrison named 'Beloved'.
 
• After it,** Sentence Q **will be used because **Sentence S** ends with **'Margaret Garner'** a black slave woman. And **Sentence Q** further explains it.
 
• **Sentence R** will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence. It explains what they did after escaping from a Kentucky plantation i.e. they sought refuge in Ohio.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence P **will be used because it tells what Margaret did before being captured by their owner and law officers.
 
• Thus, the correct Sequence is:
 
 
• **S**: The novel Beloved by Toni Morrison is based on the true story of a black slave woman, Margaret Garner.
 
• **Q**: Margaret escaped from a Kentucky plantation with her husband, Robert, and their children in 1856.
 
• **R**: They sought refuge in Ohio, but their owner and law officers soon caught up with the family.
 
• **P**: Before their recapture, Margaret killed her young daughter to prevent her return to slavery.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *The novel Beloved by Toni Morrison is based on the true story of a black slave woman, Margaret Garner. Margaret escaped from a Kentucky plantation with her husband, Robert, and their children in 1856. They sought refuge in Ohio, but their owner and law officers soon caught up with the family. Before their recapture, Margaret killed her young daughter to prevent her return to slavery.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. As a result, he had a debt of 500 million US dollars at the time of his death.

B. Unfortunately, he began spending lavishly on anything he desired, not what he actually needed.

C. Michael Jackson, called the ‘King of Pop Music’, stayed at the top of his career for many years.

D. He was respected for his work culture; he would spend long nights at the studio to fix a note correctly in a song.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**CDBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• Sentence C will be the first sentence because it is talking about Michael Jackson and this is an introductory sentence.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it further explains the kind of work he used to do the exertion he used to put in his songs.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly, Sentence A will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• C: Michael Jackson, called the ‘King of Pop Music’, stayed at the top of his career for many years.
 
• D: He was respected for his work culture; he would spend long nights at the studio to fix a note correctly in a song.
 
• B: Unfortunately, he began spending lavishly on anything he desired, not what he actually needed.
 
• A: As a result, he had a debt of 500 million US dollars at the time of his death.

 
 
 

Correct Sequence:__ *Michael Jackson, called the ‘King of Pop Music’, stayed at the top of his career for many years. He was respected for his work culture; he would spend long nights at the studio to fix a note correctly in a song. Unfortunately, he began spending lavishly on anything he desired, not what he actually needed. As a result, he had a debt of 500 million US dollars at the time of his death.*

questions.question:
**Examine the four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. Wasserkopf returns to his school and asks for a refund of his tuition fee.

B. ‘Refund’ by Karinthy is a hilarious play about a student named Wasserkopf.

C. However, the situation changes when the Mathematics teacher asks him to calculate the total amount.

D. He further declares that he had learnt nothing at school in all the years.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BADC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• **Sentence B **will be the starting line because it contains the main idea of the para jumble i.e. Refund(a play).
 
• **Sentence A** states that Wasserkopf returned to his school and asked for a refund of his tuition fee. So, **A** will follow **B**.
 
• Further,** Sentence D** states that he further declared that he was asking for a refund because he had learned nothing at school & **Sentence C **states that the situation changed when the Mathematics teacher asked him to calculate the total amount of his refund. So, **C** will follow **D**.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: ‘Refund’ by Karinthy is a hilarious play about a student named Wasserkopf.
 
• **A**: Wasserkopf returns to his school and asks for a refund of his tuition fee.
 
• **D**: He further declares that he had learnt nothing at school in all the years.
 
• **C**: However, the situation changes when the Mathematics teacher asks him to calculate the total amount.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *‘Refund’ by Karinthy is a hilarious play about a student named Wasserkopf. Wasserkopf returns to his school and asks for a refund of his tuition fee. He further declares that he had learnt nothing at school in all the years. However, the situation changes when the Mathematics teacher asks him to calculate the total amount.*
